agenda.title: Schedule & Todos

todo.quickPlaceholder: Write a todo and press Enter
todo.emptyHint: Type above and press Enter to add one

agenda.confirmDelete: Delete this item? This cannot be undone.

drawer.unsavedHint: The {{label}} you are editing has unsaved changes. Save them?

course.clearConfirm: Clear all courses for this semester? This cannot be undone and course exceptions will be removed too.
course.sidebarHint: Click an empty cell to add a course, or import from a table or image.
course.saveFirst: Save the course first, then add assignments, todos or reminders here.

import.fileHint: Pick the .xls / .xlsx file exported by your school system. The weekday x period grid is detected automatically and course name, weeks, room and teacher are extracted — no copy-paste needed.
import.textHint: Paste timetable text in any format, one course per line, any field order. Supports Mon/Wednesday, 1-2 / period 5, week 1-16, @room and teacher names.
import.fileWarnings: {{count}} cell(s) could not be parsed; add them manually after importing
import.fileEmpty: No courses found. Make sure this is a timetable exported by the school system.

daily.progressHint: Resets every day; each check-in is stored by date
daily.empty: No daily items yet. Add one to start.
daily.drawerHint: Inactive items stay out of today's list, but past check-ins are kept.
daily.note: Daily items are independent from todos. Deleting one also removes its check-in history.
daily.sidebarHint: Resets at midnight. The last 7 days are shown on the right.

timetable.weekUnset: Set a date to calculate the current week
timetable.hint: These times only affect timetable display and week calculation. They do not change events or todos.

reminder.hint: Checked every 30 seconds. In-app reminders still work when system notifications are unavailable.
reminder.muteDuringCoursesHint: Uses the timetable periods; reminders due in class are delivered after it ends.

review.hint: Write today's completed todos, events, classes and daily tasks into a note and open it right away. The previous day's review is generated automatically on the next launch.
review.generatedHint: Today's review note has been opened for you; the previous day's review is generated automatically on the next launch.

partner.title: Shared timetable
partner.hint: Add a second person's timetable: both schedules appear stacked in one grid and shared free slots are highlighted. Their courses are read-only and never trigger reminders.
partner.name: Their name
partner.empty: No courses yet. Import a file or add them later.
partner.clearConfirm: Clear all of their courses? Name and relationship are kept.

plan.title: Smart planner
plan.hint: Fills open slots by deadline and estimate. Everything is selected; uncheck as needed.
plan.empty: Nothing to schedule: add deadlines to todos or widen the range.
plan.skipped: {{count}} item(s) had no room and were left out
plan.none: These plans are already on the calendar

progress.label: Week {{current}} / {{total}}
progress.hint: Calculated from the semester start and course weeks

note.createHint: Archive a note for this course

print.title: Timetable
print.hint: Generated locally by DeskMate. Print it or save as PDF.

override.title: One-off change · {{name}}
override.hint: Applies only to the selected date; the course itself is unchanged. Timetable, planner and weekly stats all respect it.

widget.emptyScheduleHint: Today's events and classes will appear here automatically.
widget.emptyTodosHint: Overdue items and anything due today will appear here.
widget.openCombined: Open the combined desktop widget (schedule / todos)
widget.openSchedule: Pin today's schedule to the desktop
widget.openTodos: Pin today's todos to the desktop

quickTodo.title: Quick todo
quickTodo.placeholder: Write a todo and press Enter
quickTodo.hint: Enter to save · Esc to close
quickTodo.parsed: Tags, dates and priority are detected as you type
quickTodo.warnRecurrence: Recurring rules are not supported yet
